title: Amram
summary: Son of Kohath; husband of Jochebed, his father's sister; father of Aaron, Moses and Miriam; lived 137 years (Exod 6:18-20).

sorting_basis.note: No tier 1-4 dates this record's birth; unsorted (null).

standby.note: Standby placement only. Hales, A New Analysis of Chronology (1830, 2nd ed.) prints this BC/AD year on the birth entry (6. Amram 75 1803). It is not a sort year. No Anno Mundi, regnal length, or Julian Period figure was converted to obtain it.
